description: Source code for the SerialPort class in the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library, providing serial port communication functionalities including port management, data transfer, event handling, and line status monitoring.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Main class providing serial port communication functionalities including opening, configuring, reading, writing, event handling, and line status monitoring.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port currently in operation.

methods.name: isOpened
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens the serial port, throws exception if port is busy or not found.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges input/output buffers with specified flags.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets event mask for port event notifications, with special handling for Linux/Unix OS.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the serial port.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the serial port.

methods.name: closePort
methods.description: Closes the serial port, removing event listeners if any.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of control lines (CTS, DSR, RING, RLSD).

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for serial port events, with optional mask configuration.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Removes the event listener and resets event mask.
